name: Wild Rice
siboNotes: Wild rice is well-tolerated in SIBO as it's naturally low FODMAP and provides resistant starch that feeds beneficial bacteria without triggering symptoms.
preparationTips: Rinse wild rice thoroughly before cooking to remove debris
Use a 3:1 water-to-rice ratio and simmer for 45-60 minutes until grains split
Can be cooked in bone broth for added flavor and gut-healing nutrients
Store cooked wild rice in refrigerator up to 5 days or freeze for meal prep
pairsWellWith: Fresh herbs like parsley and chives
Toasted pine nuts or pumpkin seeds
Low-FODMAP vegetables like zucchini and bell peppers
nutritionalHighlights: High in protein (6.5g per cup) compared to other grains
Rich in B vitamins, particularly folate and niacin
Good source of minerals including manganese, phosphorus, and magnesium
Contains antioxidants and fiber for digestive health
